SHINE (*Social and Health Impacts of Climate Change Adaptation Efforts on Long-Term Care*) analyses how heat affects mobile long-term care in Vienna – both the people receiving care and the care staff, who are themselves strongly exposed to heat. The project assesses whether organisational adaptation and urban measures, above all greening (nature-based solutions), can offset these effects.

The project combines primary data, indicators, climate simulations and organisational analyses. New climate and heat risk maps for Vienna are used to quantify the burden on mobile care. A baseline scenario is compared with an intervention scenario that includes nature-based urban planning solutions.
